commands.prepare: Create or update host-owned sync state without publishing a start signal.
commands.start: Wait for prepared conditions and publish start.json.
commands.wait: Wait as a client until start.json exists.
commands.wait-ready: Wait as a client until the host requests ready clients.
commands.discover-ready: List sync IDs with active readiness requests.
commands.active: Write or refresh one client active heartbeat.
commands.clients: List client reports visible to the host.
commands.stop: Publish stop.json and clean active run state.
commands.cancel: Publish cancel.json and clean active run state.
commands.validate: Validate packaged UC descriptors or one sync directory.
commands.reset: Clear run state while keeping the sync folder.

outputs.stdout: JSON for all reporting commands except reset/remove success.

exit_codes.1: Validation, state, or usage-level softsync error.

output_formats.runtime_messages: JSON objects with local softsync.*.v1 schema IDs and UC portable fields.
